title: Genealogy Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day genealogy metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on genealogy metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your genealogy metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
